    # Ten years with all three matters central. The arrangement stays as it is and the journal does not
    # come back (nesnd_india_order_settled). The event nesnd_india_core.4 asks, member by member, to annex it or keep it.
    outcome = {
        header = je_standard_completion_header
        effect_header = je_standard_on_completion_header
        color = "gold_positive"
        conclusion_desc = nesnd_india_order_central_conclusion
        trigger = {
            hidden_trigger = { nesnd_india_order_live = yes }
            custom_tooltip = { text = nesnd_india_order_central_ten_tt has_variable = nesnd_india_order_central_since NOT = { has_variable = nesnd_india_order_clock_wait } }
        }
        effect = {
            set_variable = { name = nesnd_india_order_settled value = 1 }
            remove_variable = nesnd_india_order_central_since
            add_modifier = { name = nesnd_india_order_central_settled }
            save_scope_as = india_order_lord
            every_subject_or_below = {
                limit = { nesnd_india_order_member = { LORD = scope:india_order_lord } }
                root = { add_to_variable_list = { name = nesnd_india_order_annex_queue target = prev } }
            }
            trigger_event = { id = nesnd_india_core.4 popup = yes }
        }
        event_outcome_desc = { first_valid = { triggered_desc = { desc = nesnd_india_core.4_outcome_tt } } }
    }
    # Ten years with all three matters local.
    outcome = {
        header = je_standard_completion_header
        effect_header = je_standard_on_completion_header
        color = "gold_positive"
        conclusion_desc = nesnd_india_order_federal_conclusion
        trigger = {
            hidden_trigger = { nesnd_india_order_live = yes }
            custom_tooltip = { text = nesnd_india_order_local_ten_tt has_variable = nesnd_india_order_local_since NOT = { has_variable = nesnd_india_order_clock_wait } }
        }
        effect = {
            set_variable = { name = nesnd_india_order_settled value = 2 }
            remove_variable = nesnd_india_order_local_since
            add_modifier = { name = nesnd_india_order_federal_settled }
            save_scope_as = india_lobby_lord
            every_subject_or_below = {
                limit = { nesnd_india_order_member = { LORD = scope:india_lobby_lord } }
                change_relations = { country = scope:india_lobby_lord value = 30 }
                custom_tooltip = { text = nesnd_india_back_empire_lobby_tt nesnd_india_back_empire_lobby = yes }
            }
        }
    }
    # Two members left as independent countries within ten years.
    outcome = {
        header = je_standard_failure_header
        effect_header = je_standard_on_failure_header
        color = "blue_negative"
        conclusion_desc = nesnd_india_order_scattered_conclusion
        trigger = {
            hidden_trigger = { nesnd_india_order_live = yes }
            custom_tooltip = { text = nesnd_india_order_two_left_tt exists = var:nesnd_india_order_second_departed }
        }
        effect = {
            add_modifier = { name = nesnd_india_order_scattered days = normal_modifier_time }
            clear_saved_scope = india_order_gone_a
            clear_saved_scope = india_order_gone_b
            var:nesnd_india_order_first_departed ?= { save_scope_as = india_order_gone_a }
            var:nesnd_india_order_second_departed ?= { save_scope_as = india_order_gone_b }
            custom_tooltip = {
                text = nesnd_india_order_scattered_claims_tt
                scope:india_order_gone_a ?= { every_scope_state = { limit = { nesnd_india_state = yes NOT = { has_claim_by = root } } state_region = { add_claim = root } } }
                scope:india_order_gone_b ?= { every_scope_state = { limit = { nesnd_india_state = yes NOT = { has_claim_by = root } } state_region = { add_claim = root } } }
            }
            # The AI turns against the stronger of the two (GAME events/opium_wars_events.txt:254).
            custom_tooltip = {
                text = nesnd_india_order_scattered_goal_tt
                if = { limit = { exists = scope:india_order_gone_a exists = scope:india_order_gone_b scope:india_order_gone_a.gdp >= scope:india_order_gone_b.gdp }
                    set_secret_goal = { country = scope:india_order_gone_a secret_goal = antagonize }
                }
                else_if = { limit = { exists = scope:india_order_gone_b }
                    set_secret_goal = { country = scope:india_order_gone_b secret_goal = antagonize }
                }
            }
            remove_variable = nesnd_india_order_first_departed
            remove_variable = nesnd_india_order_second_departed
            nesnd_india_order_end = yes
        }
    }
    # Mughal no longer holds it (no Indian subject left, or no longer Mughal): everything is cleared.
    # The journal comes back by nesnd_india_order_upkeep once Mughal holds it again.
    outcome = {
        flags = { hidden invalid_outcome }
        conclusion_desc = nesnd_india_order_void_conclusion
        trigger = { NOT = { nesnd_india_order_live = yes } }
        effect = { nesnd_india_order_end = yes }
    }

    on_monthly_pulse = { effect = { nesnd_india_order_ai = yes nesnd_india_order_clock = yes } }
}

# ==== Mughal's old agreement, the council of princes, famine relief (formerly nesnd_india_mughal.txt) ====
# Mughal's own journals (common/scripted_effects/nesnd_india_empire.txt). Only the country holding
# nesnd_india_mughal_court gets them. Both are added each month by nesnd_mug_upkeep from
# nesnd_india_refresh; they have neither possible nor is_shown_when_inactive, so no instance exists
# until then.

# The old agreement with the overlord: selling one building level to it, or buying one back.
nesnd_mug_france = {
    icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/nesnd_india_slate.dds"
    group = je_group_historical_content
    activation_description = { always = yes }
    can_revolution_inherit = no
    weight = 760
    should_be_pinned_by_default_uninvolved_or_context = yes

    status_desc = {
        first_valid = {
            triggered_desc = { trigger = { nesnd_india_matter_kind_value = 7 } desc = nesnd_mug_france_status_sell_asked }
            triggered_desc = { trigger = { nesnd_india_matter_kind_value = 8 } desc = nesnd_mug_france_status_buyback_asked }
        }
    }

    scripted_button = nesnd_mug_sell_button
    scripted_button = nesnd_mug_buyback_button

    # No longer a subject, or the overlord's capital is now in an Indian state (nesnd_mug_foreign_overlord).
    # The old overlord is the one remembered by nesnd_mug_upkeep.
    outcome = {
        header = je_standard_completion_header
        effect_header = je_standard_on_completion_header
        color = "gold_positive"
        conclusion_desc = nesnd_mug_france_ended_conclusion
        trigger = { custom_tooltip = { text = nesnd_mug_france_closure_tt NOT = { nesnd_mug_france_live = yes } } }
        effect = {
            add_modifier = { name = nesnd_mug_old_agreement_ended }
            if = { limit = { exists = var:nesnd_mug_france_lord var:nesnd_mug_france_lord = { is_country_alive = yes } }
                var:nesnd_mug_france_lord = { save_scope_as = mug_old_lord }
                change_relations = { country = scope:mug_old_lord value = -30 }
            }
            else = { custom_tooltip = nesnd_journal_effect_revealed_tt }
            remove_variable = nesnd_mug_france_lord
        }
    }

    on_monthly_pulse = { effect = { nesnd_mug_france_ai = yes } }
}

# The council of princes, after the reform: railways, famine relief or common defence.
nesnd_mug_council = {
    icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/nesnd_india_chhatri.dds"
    group = je_group_historical_content
    activation_description = { always = yes }
    can_revolution_inherit = no
    weight = 755
    should_be_pinned_by_default_uninvolved_or_context = yes

    reason = {
        first_valid = {
            triggered_desc = { trigger = { has_variable = nesnd_mug_council_topic } desc = nesnd_mug_council_reason_sitting }
            triggered_desc = { trigger = { has_variable = nesnd_mug_council_wait } desc = nesnd_mug_council_reason_rest }
            desc = nesnd_mug_council_reason_ready
        }
    }

    scripted_button = nesnd_mug_council_button

    # Three councils agreed: the council becomes an institution and is not called again.
    outcome = {
        header = je_standard_completion_header
        effect_header = je_standard_on_completion_header
        color = "gold_positive"
        conclusion_desc = nesnd_mug_council_settled_conclusion
        trigger = { hidden_trigger = { nesnd_mug_council_live = yes } custom_tooltip = { text = nesnd_mug_council_three_agreed_tt nesnd_mug_council_agreed_value >= 3 } }
        effect = {
            set_variable = nesnd_mug_council_settled
            add_modifier = { name = nesnd_mug_council_established }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = nesnd_mug_council_did_rail } add_modifier = { name = nesnd_mug_council_rail_lasting } }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = nesnd_mug_council_did_relief } add_modifier = { name = nesnd_mug_council_relief_lasting } }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = nesnd_mug_council_did_defence } add_modifier = { name = nesnd_mug_council_defence_lasting } }
            save_scope_as = mug_council_convener
            every_country = {
                limit = { has_variable = nesnd_mug_council_attended nesnd_india_prince = yes }
                change_relations = { country = scope:mug_council_convener value = 20 }
            }
            remove_variable = nesnd_mug_council_agreed
            remove_variable = nesnd_mug_council_empty
            remove_variable = nesnd_mug_council_did_rail
            remove_variable = nesnd_mug_council_did_relief
            remove_variable = nesnd_mug_council_did_defence
        }
    }
    # Three councils in a row that no prince attended: no council for three years, then the journal returns.
    outcome = {
        header = je_standard_failure_header
        effect_header = je_standard_on_failure_header
        color = "blue_negative"
        conclusion_desc = nesnd_mug_council_failed_conclusion
        trigger = { hidden_trigger = { nesnd_mug_council_live = yes } custom_tooltip = { text = nesnd_mug_council_three_empty_tt nesnd_mug_council_empty_value >= 3 } }
        effect = {
            add_modifier = { name = nesnd_mug_council_failed days = 1095 }
            custom_tooltip = nesnd_mug_council_closed_tt
            set_variable = { name = nesnd_mug_council_closed months = 36 }
            remove_variable = nesnd_mug_council_empty
        }
    }
    # No longer Mughal past the reform.
    outcome = {
        flags = { hidden invalid_outcome }
        conclusion_desc = nesnd_mug_council_void_conclusion
        trigger = { NOT = { nesnd_mug_council_live = yes } }
    }

    on_monthly_pulse = { effect = { nesnd_mug_council_ai = yes } }
}
